findings.title: Contradictory contact-target completeness evidence still authorizes mutation
findings.observation: The target-query validator requires diagnostics.truncated to be Boolean but does not validate truncationReason/truncation_reason type, alias agreement, or coherence with truncated=false. A response that simultaneously claims complete and supplies a limit reason is treated as complete.
findings.trigger: A canonical contact-target query returns one candidate with diagnostics.truncated=false and truncationReason='limit' (or conflicting reason aliases), after which open_contact/send_message continues.
findings.impact: The workflow mutates the UI on evidence that explicitly says the candidate set may be incomplete, so a hidden duplicate can cause the wrong conversation to be selected and sensitive text to be sent.

evidence.description: Lines 5312-5349 validate the Boolean flag and returnedNodes but never inspect truncation reason aliases or their consistency.
Track A exact-head contradiction probe recorded accessibility_query -> accessibility_action -> accessibility_query and one post-query mutation; exit 3.
Independent Track B WeChat pass reproduced full action, draft, and submit for truncated=false plus truncationReason=limit.

findings.remediation: Validate every completeness alias by presence and type, require all copies to agree, reject a reason when truncated=false, and make any malformed or contradictory completeness evidence final before action, click, Return, draft, or submit.
findings.verification: Add cross-product tests for Boolean flag, reason presence/type, camel/snake alias conflicts, and each target strategy; every invalid case must end after its decision query with zero downstream mutation.

findings.title: Duplicate, outer, and contradictory query evidence still normalizes as success
findings.observation: The unwrapping routine returns the first direct or nested query mapping and discards other visible wrappers and outer ToolObservation failure evidence. The normalizer also accepts success with a non-failure error container and does not enforce truncation-reason alias agreement or false/reason coherence.
findings.trigger: A failed outer ToolObservation wraps a successful accessibilityQuery, direct and nested accessibilityQuery copies disagree, a success carries error.message, or diagnostics says truncated=false while supplying a truncation reason.
findings.impact: A failed or incomplete query can produce a resolved element and cache entry. Callers then receive an actionable target even though the complete transport envelope says the query failed or was incomplete.

evidence.description: Lines 1040-1071 select one wrapper without reconciling duplicate/outer evidence; truncation reason normalization uses the first truthy alias.
Track A duplicate-wrapper matrix resolved all four conflicting envelopes; exit 4.
Track B selector probe resolved and cached outer-failed, duplicate-wrapper, error-container, false-plus-reason, and conflicting-reason-alias cases; exit 31.
The remediation design requires malformed wrappers and conflicting duplicate metadata to fail closed.

findings.remediation: Before selecting a payload, inventory every visible envelope/wrapper and relevant outer field, validate types, require duplicate aliases/copies to agree, and reject any success carrying contradictory failure or completeness evidence. Rejected results must never resolve or populate cache.
findings.verification: Add direct-vs-nested, outer-vs-inner, error-container, false-plus-reason, and conflicting alias matrices with assertions for failed status, no elements, and no cache write.

findings.title: Search-target cardinality, identity, and structure still fail open before send
findings.observation: Search candidates are capped at ten before cardinality is established, contact matching uses substring rather than normalized exact equality, postcondition confidence also accepts substrings, and missing/invalid AX paths are coerced to '0'. The target gate does not prove the candidate belongs to the verified WeChat window.
findings.trigger: Examples include exact duplicates at returned rows 1 and 11, request 'Ada' with sole row/title 'Ada Lovelace', a missing/numeric AX path, or a TextEdit-origin node with a plausible frame.
findings.impact: The tool can select an ambiguous or wrong contact, perform an Accessibility action or coordinate click, draft sensitive text, and press Return to submit it.

evidence.description: Lines 5177-5185 cap rows at ten and use substring matching; lines 3917-3919 synthesize a path; lines 6177-6182 accept substring postconditions.
Track A partial-name full-send probe completed action, draft, and submit; exit 43.
Malformed/missing path cases completed the send path; exit 46.
An 11-row response with matching rows 1 and 11 was treated as unique and submitted; exit 45.
The remediation design requires exact normalized-name cardinality and a structurally valid in-window target before mutation.

findings.remediation: Compute exact-name cardinality over the complete validated candidate set, reject any semantic cap that can hide a duplicate, require valid in-snapshot AX path/frame/action evidence and verified WeChat app/window provenance, and use the same exact identity rule for postconditions.
findings.verification: Add >10-row duplicate, partial-name-only, missing/malformed path, wrong-app/window, offscreen, and valid exact-one controls; invalid cases must record zero action/click/Return/draft/submit after the decision query.

findings.title: Explicit malformed roots and no-op matchers silently broaden selector profiles
findings.observation: Selector root parsing uses truthiness, so an explicitly present falsey root is treated as absent and silently defaults to focusedWindow. Attribute matcher parsing/validation also accepts empty matchers, equals:null, and unknown v1 keys such as anyOf, producing a matcher with no effective predicate.
findings.trigger: Load an otherwise valid profile whose selector root is {}, false, 0, empty string/list, or null, or whose AXDescription matcher is {}, {equals:null}, or {anyOf:['Contacts']}; then resolve against a non-matching Settings node.
findings.impact: Malformed or version-skewed configuration activates instead of failing closed, broadens the search root/predicate, resolves the wrong UI element at confidence 1.0, and can supply an action target.

evidence.description: Lines 102-104 use root_data truthiness; lines 182-198 ignore unknown matcher keys; validation only checks regex, alias_ref, and empty any_of.
Independent exact-head selector probe resolved all six falsey roots and all three no-op/version-skewed matchers; wrong label Settings resolved after one query; exit 31.
The field contract requires SelectorDefinition.root and SelectorRoot.kind; malformed custom profiles are documented to be rejected before query.

findings.remediation: Parse root by key presence, rejecting every present non-mapping or incomplete value; require at least one effective attribute predicate and reject unknown v1 matcher keys or unsupported aliases before override activation.
findings.verification: Add falsey-present-root and matcher key/predicate matrices. Every malformed profile must raise the stable validation failure and execute zero queries; include absent-root compatibility controls only where a documented default is allowed.

required_actions.action: Reject all malformed, conflicting, or incoherent completeness aliases before any contact-target mutation; add strategy-wide zero-side-effect order tests.
Reconcile all outer/inner/duplicate query evidence and completeness aliases before resolution; add no-element and no-cache matrices.
Require complete-set exact-name cardinality plus structurally valid in-WeChat-window target proof before action/click/draft/submit.
Reject explicit malformed roots, no-op/null matchers, and unknown v1 matcher keys before profile activation and query.
